paraphrase: The bijective enumerations of a fixed Nat-labeled roster have cardinality 2^aleph0, strictly greater than aleph0. Transporting the strict Nat order along an enumeration is injective, and the range of these distinct labeled order relations itself has cardinality 2^aleph0. This counts labeled orders of type omega (or their reversals), not unlabeled order types or independently established possible causal histories.
